title: Professor Aderibigbe M. O. Shonubi is a distinguished consultant paediatric surgeon with a rich academic and professional background. Born on March 19, 1951, in Lagos, he began his education in various schools before earning his MB.BS from the University of Ibadan in 1976. He further specialized in paediatric surgery at the University of Liverpool, obtaining a certificate in 1984. With extensive experience in both Nigeria and abroad, he has held numerous positions, including Senior Lecturer and Consultant at Olabisi Onabanjo University and various hospitals. He has contributed significantly to the field through his roles in academic administration and numerous publications. Professor Shonubi is also a member of several professional bodies and is happily married with children.
